name: Granite aeUSDC

priceBasis.protocol: pyth-adapter-v1: Pyth Lazer feed 1 (BTC) for sBTC collateral and feed 7 (USDC/USD) for aeUSDC debt (aeUSDC is priced as USDC), max age 300 s
priceBasis.monitor: 7-venue CEX median for BTC and USDC; interest accrued to the block with the protocol's own accrue-interest read-only

bandSource: BTC 0.60%: max Lazer-vs-reference deviation at block time in successful priced txs (measured from 1,583 decoded Lazer-carrying txs, 2026-08-13..09-22). USDC 0.25%: estimate [E], not yet measured.

prices.method: median of last traded 1m candle close (<=300 s old) before block time; USDT quotes x median USDT/USD (kraken, coinbase)

discovery.method: every principal in state-v1's transaction history (sender, top-level contract, call arguments); positions + user-collaterals map reads at the block

checks.label: Debt shares: Σ positions vs state-v1 total-debt-shares
sBTC collateral: Σ positions vs sBTC held by state-v1
